title: Three SEO release candidates recovered and reverified
summary: Confirmed current production identity and preserved three existing isolated commits. Fresh local suites passed 95, 94 and 94 tests. Deployment remains unauthorized; no runtime source changes.

changes.detail: Added a master continuation handoff containing exact candidate SHAs/files, feature classification, validation limits, release order and rollback references.
